# Almenara

> Almenara is a Madrid-based LED technology company. It designs and licenses a high-efficacy LED light engine (over 275 lumens per watt) that goes inside luminaires: it integrates into new products and replaces the light source in fixtures already installed, without changing the housing, optics or installation. It cuts lighting energy consumption by more than 50% against standard installations.

Almenara does not make luminaires. It supplies the light engine to luminaire manufacturers, lighting studios and infrastructure operators, and offers retrofit engineering, light as a service (no upfront investment) and technical advisory.

Key facts:
- Luminous efficacy: over 275 lm/W (commercial LED luminaires typically deliver 130–200 lm/W)
- Energy reduction versus standard installations: over 50%
- Compatibility: universal, retrofit-ready; same photometric distribution, housing and installation
- Operating temperature: −40 °C to +85 °C; colour temperature and beam angle configurable
- Certification: CE, RoHS, ENEC; European Union approval certificate; Portuguese national recognition for energy saving; National Energy Saving Prize (IBM offices retrofit, Mexico City)
- Sectors: hospitality, architecture and museums, industry and logistics, retail, public infrastructure and street lighting, premium residential, data centres
- Partners sought: luminaire manufacturers, specifiers and lighting studios, and infrastructure operators who want to integrate or license the light engine
- Headquarters: Madrid, Spain. Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian
- Contact: info@almenaraled.com
